name: "DevSecOps IaC Security Gate"

# Run this automated check whenever code is pushed or a PR is opened
on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  iac-security-scan:
    name: "Run IaC Security Scans"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # Step 1: Pull down the code from the GitHub repository
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      # Step 2: Install Terraform inside the GitHub runner environment
      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
        with:
          terraform_version: 1.5.0

      # Step 3: Validate syntax
      - name: Terraform Init & Validate
        run: |
          terraform init -backend=false
          terraform validate

      # Step 4: Run tfsec to scan for cloud security misconfigurations
      # HARD FAIL: Stop the build if high risks are found
      - name: Run tfsec Security Scan
        uses: aquasecurity/tfsec-action@v1.0.0
        with:
          working_directory: .
          soft_fail: false

      # Step 5: Run Checkov policy checks
      - name: Run Checkov Static Analysis
        uses: bridgecrewio/checkov-action@master
        with:
          framework: terraform
          output_format: cli
          soft_fail: false
